title: pilosella glaucescens subsp. kerneri
intro: Pilosella glaucescens subsp. kerneri, commonly known as a subspecies of the plant Pilosella glaucescens, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella glaucescens subsp. kerneri include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
